note: SNS-2026-10-STAGE6-MESSAGES-001: Stage 6 targeted Messages/DMs reliability repair. Active DM system: /chats/{chatId} (messages stored as array in doc). _ibSending flag added to _ibSend() to prevent double-send on rapid Enter/tap. _ibSending correctly reset on all early-return paths (block gate, empty input, AI scan). Send failure now logs [SNS Messages] Send failed: and restores user text on error. Conversation list snapshot error now logs [SNS Messages] Conversation load failed:. _ibToMs() helper added to safely coerce Firestore Timestamp objects, plain timestamp objects, and numeric ms — prevents crash on legacy message records. Messages sorted oldest→newest via _ibToMs before rendering. sortedList hoisted to function scope so lastMsg read-receipt check is correct. Conversation list displayName now falls back to username before truncated UID. Normal feed posts no longer receive expiresAt — permanent by default. Reposts also made permanent. Legacy posts with expiresAt continue to expire. Stories and announcements retain their own separate TTL. TTL_MS constant kept for legacy cleanup query only. SW bumped to v79.
